value.rationale: The full character of the natural order-n^2 translation group for each odd-order cyclic Latin-square clique complex distinguishes three geometrically motivated dual directions and determines quotient invariant dimension. Existing Betti numbers omit precisely this equivariant structure, and the formula holds uniformly including odd composite n.
